SHIPPING.TITLE: Shipping Settings
SHIPPING.SUBTITLE: Define shipping zones (groups of countries) and the rate ranges that apply to each — by total weight or by order total. Multiple ranges with the same name form one rate group, automatically checked for gaps and overlaps.
SHIPPING.NO_ZONES: No zones yet — click Add zone to define your first delivery region.

ZONE.NAME: Zone name
ZONE.CONFIRM_DELETE: Delete zone "{{name}}"? Its rates will be removed too.
ZONE.DUPLICATE_NAME: Another zone already uses this name.

RATES.TITLE: Rates
RATES.GROUP_NOTE_PH: Shown to the customer at checkout
RATES.ERR_RANGE: From must be ≥ 0 and To must be greater than From.
RATES.EMPTY: No rates yet — add a rate group to start charging for shipments to this zone.

SHIPPING.ERR_UNSAVED_GROUP: You have unsaved rate-group edits. Save or cancel them before saving the page.
SHIPPING.ERR_VALIDATION: Fix the highlighted errors before saving.

OPTIONS.TITLE: Additional settings
OPTIONS.HINT: Configure the tax on delivery charges and the unit used for weight-based shipping rates.

SHIPPING_DELIVERY.TITLE: Shipping & Delivery
SHIPPING_DELIVERY.SUBTITLE: Pick how the storefront fulfils orders, then configure rates for the active mode. Only the active mode is used at checkout — the other editors stay accessible so you can prepare them in advance.
SHIPPING_DELIVERY.HINT_SHIPPING: Country-based zones with weight or order-total ranges. Used when you ship across borders.
SHIPPING_DELIVERY.HINT_DELIVERY_ADDRESS: Per-area delivery economics keyed by Governorate / City / Block. Best when areas are well-defined administrative units.
SHIPPING_DELIVERY.HINT_DELIVERY_ZONE: Radius-based zones around each branch's pinned location. Best when areas are defined by distance from the branch.
SHIPPING_DELIVERY.UNSAVED_HINT: You have unsaved changes to the fulfilment mode.
